title: Horse Riding
subtitle: Ride through open fields
description: Ride at ASTBAL in our training arena, equipped with the latest riding equipment and run by an experienced trainer. Beginners and experienced riders are both welcome. Take a riding lesson, or relax on a leisure ride while our trainer leads your horse through the fields.
longDescription: Our stable houses beautiful, well-trained horses that love company. Take a riding lesson in the training arena, or enjoy a peaceful leisure ride: you sit on the horse and our trainer leads it through the fields around the farm. Beginners get a safety briefing first. You can also spend time with the horses on the ground: take photos with them, learn their daily routine of feeding and grooming, and learn about the different horse breeds.
highlights: Training arena with the latest equipment
Riding lessons for beginners and experienced riders
Leisure rides through the fields, led by our trainer
Learn the daily routine: feeding and grooming

title: Guava Orchard
subtitle: Pick your own fresh guavas
description: Step into our lush guava orchard and hand-pick the freshest, juiciest guavas you've ever tasted. There's nothing quite like eating fruit straight from the tree. Take a basket, wander through the trees, and fill it with nature's candy.
longDescription: Our guava orchard is a labor of love — rows upon rows of guava trees heavy with fruit. The experience of walking among the trees, smelling the sweet fragrance, and picking guavas at peak ripeness is something that connects you to the land. You can eat them fresh or take some back to the kitchen where our cook can prepare guava desserts and salads.
highlights: Seasonal — best from July to February

title: Kitchen Garden
subtitle: Pick fresh, seasonal vegetables
description: Visit our kitchen garden where we grow fresh vegetables, herbs and greens through the seasons. Pick what's ready and take home the freshest vegetables you'll find.
longDescription: Our kitchen garden is the heart of ASTBAL's farm-to-table food. Rows of tomatoes, peppers, spinach, herbs and other seasonal vegetables, all grown on the property. Walk the beds with us and pick what's in season. What's available depends on the time of year, and rates depend on the vegetable and the quantity you pick.
highlights: Rates as per vegetable and quantity

title: In-House Restaurant
subtitle: Farm-to-table dining
description: Our in-house kitchen serves home-style meals made with fresh ingredients from the property. Start the day with a farm fresh breakfast, and add an optional farm-to-table dinner cooked with seasonal vegetables from the farm.
longDescription: Food at ASTBAL is more than just meals — it's an experience. Our cook specializes in rustic, home-style cooking that showcases the best of Haryana's culinary traditions. Every dish uses ingredients sourced from our kitchen garden, guava orchard, and local farms. Enjoy your meals al fresco with views of the open fields, or cozy up indoors during the cooler months.
highlights: Al fresco dining with field views

title: Meet Our Dogs
subtitle: Your furry companions await
description: ASTBAL is home to friendly dogs — both Indian canines and Labradors — who love meeting guests. They'll greet you at the gate, accompany you on walks around the property, and fill your stay with unconditional love and joy. Dog lovers, this is heaven!
longDescription: Our dogs are part of the ASTBAL family. The Labradors are gentle, playful, and great with children — they love belly rubs and playing fetch in the fields. Our Indian canines are loyal, intelligent, and the perfect companions for nature walks around the property. They add warmth and life to every stay.
